payload.title: Generate EC Data
payload.description: This notebook processes global mean annual temperature timeseries data from 18 paleoclimate models to produce datasets for analyzing temperature variability and its relationship with climate sensitivity.

steps.description: Import necessary libraries for data manipulation, statistical analysis, and visualization. Set matplotlib configurations for consistent plotting aesthetics.
steps.title: Import Libraries and Set Configurations

steps.description: Define a function to convert sulfuric aerosol optical depth (SAOD) into radiative forcing values, which will be used in the regression analysis.
steps.title: Define Forcing Function

steps.description: Load the global mean annual 'tas' temperature timeseries and SAOD data. Preprocess the data to ensure it is ready for analysis, including handling missing values and aligning datasets.
steps.title: Load and Preprocess Data

steps.description: Conduct linear regression to regress out the volcanic forcing from the temperature timeseries. Calculate residuals for further analysis.
steps.title: Perform Regression Analysis

steps.description: Compute temperature variability metrics from the residuals obtained after regression. These metrics will be used to analyze the relationship with ECS values.
steps.title: Calculate Temperature Variability Metrics

steps.description: Save the calculated temperature variability metrics and residuals to 'ec_data.csv' and 'ts_rv.csv' respectively for further analysis.
steps.title: Save Processed Data
